title: Fleet Info
description: Optional Object containing information if the Card is a part of a Fleet managed program

oneOf.description: Driver Number was not provided as part of the transaction
Vehicle Number was not provided as part of the transaction

fleet_restriction_code.description: Code indicating which restrictions, if any, there are on purchase. This is configured at a program level and is a static configuration, and does not change on a request to request basis

fleet_prompt_code.description: Code indicating what the driver was prompted to enter at time of purchase. This is configured at a program level and is a static configuration, and does not change on a request to request basis
